programs.title: Secrets of the Bees: Season 1
programs.desc: National Geographic traveler and explorer, Bertie Gregory, takes viewers on a fascinating journey into the world of bees.For three years, the creators of the documentary conducted observations, using specialized cameras placed inside the hive to capture the life of these insects up close.The film reveals their complex architecture, social behavior and extraordinary intelligence of over 20,000 species of bees.They are responsible for pollinating one third of the food produced in the world and are considered one of the most important animals on our planet.

programs.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes
programs.desc: Nigel Marven travels in the footsteps of the ten most dangerous snakes in the world.It travels through humid equatorial forests and deserts in search of these reptiles.

programs.title: Europe From Above 5
programs.desc: The Old Continent seen from an extraordinary perspective.A bird's eye view will allow you to discover architectural treasures as well as natural gems.Europe will also be shown during different seasons.
